item.title: Iran rejects U.S. ceasefire plan as missiles continue to fly across Middle East
item.summary: Iran on Wednesday dismissed an American plan to pause the war in the Middle East and launched more attacks on Israel and Gulf Arab countries, including an assault that sparked a huge fire at Kuwait International Airport.

item.title: Are Iranian 'sleeper cells' a threat to Canadians? Here’s what intelligence experts say
item.summary: Rhetoric around Iranian sleeper cells has spiked since the onset of the U.S.-Israel war with Iran. Counter-intelligence experts and a former spy tell CBC News that while the regime may not use dormant agents in Canada, the threats of lone wolf attacks and 'criminal proxies' ar...

item.title: Israel's defence minister says military plans occupy swath of southern Lebanon
item.summary: Israel will occupy southern Lebanon up to the Litani River to create a "defensive buffer," Defence Minister Israel Katz said on Tuesday, spelling out for the first time Israel's intent to seize territory amounting to nearly a tenth of Lebanon.

item.title: Cuban health-care workers struggle to support the sick amid U.S. oil embargo
item.summary: Young health-care providers at Havana’s Cardiology Institute describe a double-whammy of desperation in their work and private lives. They're anxious about what the future holds since a U.S. oil embargo in January led to dramatic fuel shortages in Cuba, along with soaring food...

item.title: Record-breaking heat dome growing to cover nearly the entire U.S.
item.summary: A huge heat dome is spreading across the United States. After breaking March records in 14 states with temperatures as high as 44.4 C, it's now widening and may become the most expansive heat dome ever.

item.title: Jury in Los Angeles finds Meta and YouTube liable in landmark social media addiction trial
item.summary: A jury in Los Angeles found both Meta and YouTube liable in a first-of-its-kind lawsuit that aimed to hold social media platforms responsible for harm to children using their services, awarding the plaintiff $3 million US in damages.

item.title: Humanoid robot joins Melania Trump at White House for summit on technology and kids
item.summary: Melania Trump was accompanied by a humanoid companion on Wednesday, as she arrived at the White House East Room for the final day of a summit she had convened with counterparts from around the world through her Fostering the Future Together global initiative.

item.title: Plane crash investigators held up by airport delays as partial U.S. shutdown continues
item.summary: Specialists investigating the Air Canada plane crash at LaGuardia Airport that killed two pilots were held up by delays at other airports Monday, according to the U.S. National Transportation Safety Board, as a partial U.S. government shutdown is causing security delays across...

item.title: Minnesota sues Trump administration for access to evidence in killings of Renée Good, Alex Pretti
item.summary: Officials in Minnesota sued the Trump administration Tuesday for access to evidence they say they need to independently investigate three shootings in the state earlier this year by federal officers, including the killings of Renee Good and Alex Pretti.
